tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed drug cu pa ngor lugs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig brjod pa// swasti/ 'jigs byed drug cu pa ngor lugs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig brjod na/ bzlas pa'i skabs su drag po'i dmigs pa ni/ rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa la sgrub bsnyen gyi dmigs pa de bsgom pas chog kyang / ngor lugs la ma dar bas/ ngor lugs kyi drag po'i dmigs pa ni/ slob dpon shrī bha dra'i sgrub thabs las/ sngags kyi yi ge 'od zer las/ khro bo sna tshogs pa dang / bya sna tshogs pa dang / 'dre dang srin po la sogs pa dang / 'jigs su rung ba rnams spros te/ sgrub bya'i sha dang / rus pa dang / khrag dang / chu ser rnams za zhing 'thung ba dang 'jib par bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin bsgom/ hrīḥṣṭīḥl 'bod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma dang / rwa lugs thun mong ma yin la yig spungs myur sor brjod pa zhig snang ba bzhin/ 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba chen po'ang rgyun de bzhin mdzad/ 'on kyang mgon de'i gsung las/ 'di la hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ zhes sogs bzlas na 'gal ba med cing / ngor lugs dang mthun zhes gsungs pa bzhin bya'o/ /phyogs skyong 'di dag 'byung po rang rgyud pa dang ye shes pa'i sprul pa gang yin zhe na/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnam sprul las/ /zhes gsungs pas ye shes pa'i lha 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba yin pas 'o kol sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams dam tshig tshul mthun bsrung na chos skyong mdzad la/ dam tshig ma srung na rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'di dag kyang gnod 'dre lta bur song nas/ de'i 'khor 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bar chad byed pas na phan gnod gnyis ka'i bdag po yin/ 'di dag 'jig rten pa'i gzugs su bkug pa'i gzhi dang / phur gdab sogs kyi lam dang / lhar bsgyur bas 'bras bu mtshon no/ /'di dag la gtor bsngo'i skabs su sgrub thabs las/

phur gdab sogs rgyas par ma gsungs par skad cig gi phur gdab dang / lhar sgyur ba lta bu mdzad 'dug kyang / las dang po pa rnams kyis dmigs pa myur po 'di 'dra shin tu dka' bas/ dkon mchog lhun grub nyid kyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi gsal byed bsnyen sgrub rnam rol las/ phyogs skyong bkug tshar ba'i rjes su 'di skad gsungs te/ phyogs skyong ba rnams mdun du 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin dkar po zhes sogs nas/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba zhes pa'i bar dang / phur bus btab pas rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur par bsam pa'i bar phrin las char 'bebs bzhin zhes gsungs pas/ rgyun kyi gtor bsngo la'ang phur btab dang / bskyed chog rgyas pa bya'o/ /phur btab tshar nas phyogs skyong rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa'i sgom don la brgya byin/ chu lha/ dbang ldan gsum dkar po 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i gri thod/ gshin rje dang srin po gnyis sngon po rdo rje gri gug gnod sbyin tshangs pa sa lha gsum ser po rin chen gri gug me lha dmar po padma gri gug rlung lha ljang khu rgya gram gri gug thams cad kyi g.yon thod khrag so so'i mdog dang mthun pa'i ma he'i gdong pa/ ma he'i gdan can kho na yin pa 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi drug cu go don las kyang / kho bo ni rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi tshe thams cad la mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan yod pas mi bskyod pa'i rigs gcig rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog nag po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang / tshar chen rin po ches zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi rang rang gi zhon pa la gnas par gsungs pas/ phyogs skyong so so'i gdan gyi steng du rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med dam snyam zhing / khyad par drag po'i las ni/ tshul 'di shin tu 'thad dam snyam/

las gshin 'di yang rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir 'chi bdag gi gzugs su sprul nas gshin rje rang rgyud pa rnams kyi gnyen po yin par rgyud dang / rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams dgongs pa mthun no/ /las gshin 'di la bsnyen pa byed tshul ni 'jigs byed kyi gzhi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsung bzhin shes par bya'o/ /yang gur drag yang phur sogs yi dam gzhan gyi bdag bskyed byas/ rang re'i gtor bsngo chen mo dang lhan cig 'jigs byed la gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma thams cad dus gcig la byin brlabs ni kyai rdor bzhin byed dgos/ 'on kyang phur gur drag gi gtor ma byin brlabs des go mi chod dam snyam na go chod mod kyi gsang sngags gsar rnying gi cho ga mi bsre ba'i phyir/ rnying lugs kyi yi dam sgom bzlas byas kyang / 'og na gsar ma'i yi dam chos bsrung shas che ba yod tshe gsar ma'i yi dam gtso che ba zhig gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma thams cad dus gcig la byin brlabs mdzad nas so so'i gtor bsngo'i tshe byin brlabs dran tsam byed pa sa lo'i phyag len yin/ phyag len de la kyai rdor gtso bor 'byung ba ni bla ma sa skya pa chen po la yi dam 'di'i smin grol gyi gdams pa zab dgu cha lag dang bcas pa bka' babs pa nas bzung dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun ma nub par brgyud 'dzin phal cher gyi thugs nyams su bzhes pa sogs yi dam gyi gtso bo yin phyir ro/ /gang ltar bde kyai gtor bsngo grub nas 'jigs byed gtor bsngo byas la/ gur zhal nas phur bsrung gi bar byas mthar phyogs skyong las gshin gyi gtor bsngo spyi gtor gzhi bdag sogs dang / phur bsrung gi bzlas mjug tu las gshin gyi sngags thung gnyis bzla/ de bzhin du bde kyai sogs yi dam gzhan gyi bdag bskyed byas nas 'jig byed la gtor ma 'bul tshe gsar ma yin phyin bdag bskyed gang byas des gtor ma byin brlabs rgyas pa byas nas/

yi dam chos skyong gzhan la phul bas 'thus so/ /'jigs byed drug cu pa'i skabs su mkho ba'i 'jigs byed mchod phreng stong gsum ma'i sngags rnams nag 'gros ma ni/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra ba maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhu paṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra badzra gandhe pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra badzra nai wi dya pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra badzra shapta pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra a laṃ kṛ ta pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swāhā/ phyogs skyong la phur gdab kyi sngags nag 'gros ma ni/ oṃ ind+ra ya badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mā ya badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ wa ru ṇā badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ku be rā ya badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ i shwa rā ya badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ agna ye badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ nirti tya ye badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ wa ya be badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ brahma ṇa ye badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pri thi wi bhyaḥbadzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes phur btab kyi sngags rgyas pa dang / bsdu na/ oṃ ind+ra ya/ ya mā ya/ wa ru ṇā ya/ ku be rā ya/ i shwa rā ya/ agna ye/ nirti tya ye/ wa ya be/ brahma ṇa ye/ pri thi wi bhyaḥ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes so/ /las gshin mchod phreng gi sngags rnams nag 'gros ma ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma ra dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/

oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ puṣpe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma ra dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ dhu pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma ra dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ dī paṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ gandhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nai wi dye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ shapta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ba lye dāe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di rnams 'jigs byed drug cu pa ngor lugs kyi skabs su dgos rgyu yin/ yang rol 'chams sogs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba rnams brjod na/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mgon po drug cu pa'i rol mo'i rnam gzhag las 'di ltar gsungs te/ deng sang gi rol mo byed pa rnams ni/ stod smad bar gsum gang du nyan par phyin kyang che chung dang len lugs sogs mtshams ma chod pa'i gar rdeg 'dir rdeg med pa zhig byas par brten nas gang yin ngo gcig kyang mi shes pa bdag lta bu rmongs pa dpe rgyu ci yang med pa zhig yong gin 'dug na'ang / mkhyen rab can tsho'i dgongs pa zhig los yod/ gang ltar kyang spyir gyi rol mo len lugs la/ til mar ma sogs dmigs bsal re re gnyis re ma gtogs/ thog mar bcom pa'i rol mo cung chung ba zhig nges par dgos/ de rjes len pa de cung che ba zhig dgos/ 'di gnyis kyi rol mo la bcom len gyi rol mo zer ba yin/

lar chems brdung la bcom par bshad pa yang yod pas blo chung rnams ma 'khrul ba gal che'o/ /de nas bcom len gnyis kyi rjes su rol mo dngos gzhi gang yin brdeg pa ste/ dper na gsum brdeg lta bu zhig brdeg pa'i tshe che chung thams cad grangs su bgrangs na gsum brdeg len med la dgu dang / len bcas la bcu gcig 'byung ngo / /dpe de bzhin du nyis brdeg la'ang len med la bdun dang / len bcas la dgu 'byung bas so sor nges par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang re'i phyag len mthong brgyud la 'khrul med bzhugs 'dug kyang / a ṇi btsun ma la 'dod yon lnga dris pa'i dpe ltar/ gang yin dris na phal cher la shod rgyu mi 'dug kyang lag len gyi tshe 'khrul med yong 'dug pas 'gal ba cher ma mchis/ tshul de lta bu'i 'og nas 'byung ba rnams la'ang nges shes bskyed nas/ 'dir 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i skabs su rang re'i phyag len rol mo rnams dang bstun/ zor 'chams cung zad bya tshul ni/ thog mar slob dpon drag chas gyon nas drag rol hob thag pa chems brdung rkang gling bcas byas la/ chems brdung gi tshe rdor dril thogs pa'i lag gnyis mdun du cung zad 'gul/ chung gsum la lag 'gul che ba'i bcom dang sbraṃ zhes pa'i tshe mdun du mnan la/ gcig zhes pa'i tshe lag gnyis rol stabs dang / rkang g.yas glo bur du rgyab kyi g.yas zur du bzhag gnyis zhes pa'i tshe lag stabs de ka'i ngang nas rkang g.yas mdun du spos/ gsum zhes pa'i tshe lag stabs 'dra/ rkang g.yas g.yon gyi rgyab zur du spos/ byas zhes pa'i tshe lag gnyis pad skor lta bu dang / yang gcig zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas mdun du spos/ gnyis zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yon shugs la mdun du slebs yong / gsum zhes pa'i tshe rkang lag gnyis mdun du mnan/ gcig zhes pa'i tshe lag gnyis mdun du 'jog tshul byed/ de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du lus nem yig che bar byed/

dbyangs kyi skabs su la mgo gnyis cung zad 'gul tsam re/ mche we/ bzhi ye zhes rnga brda' sprad la/ gtsigs ye/ pa wa can zhes pa rnams rol mo dang bstun/ lag g.yas g.yon la bskor la yangs pa'i pad kor gyi mdun du bzhag dbyangs rdzogs pa'i rol mo gsum brdeg len can la/ sbraṃ zhes mdun du sgur/ sbraṃ zhes rkang pa g.yas rgyab tu spos/ gcig la g.yas/ gnyis la mdun/ gsum la g.yon du spos/ lag stabs rol pa yin/ yang gsum brdung dang / che gcig la lag stabs rkang stabs gong bzhin/ 'dur shur rnams kyi skabs lag mgo 'gul tsam/ tshig rol gyi tshe lag gnyis khro bo'i sdigs mdzub kha phub dang / rkang g.yas rtse btsugs rgyab tu sig cing skor/ gcig zhes pa'i tshe glo bur rkang g.yas g.yon du bskyal/ dku g.yon thad g.yas g.yobs/ g.yon g.yon gyi nu steng du kha phub/ gnyis zhes pa'i tshe g.yas su bsgyur la g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon lte ba'i thad du kha gyen bstan/ gsum zhes pa'i tshe lag gnyis g.yas su brkyang / de nas dgu rdung la lag gnyis rol stabs kyi g.yas nas mdun bskor/ bdun brgyad ces pa'i dus g.yas phyir bsdu zhing / g.yon mdun la bskor la gnyis pad skor ltar byas la thugs kar mnyam pa dang dgu/ zhes dang / gcig zhes pa la lus nem che ba dang / g.yas g.yas 'phyar/ gnyis zhes pa la g.yon g.yon 'phyar/ gsum zhes pa la lag gnyis mdun du 'jog tshul/ 'chams tshul 'di la gong 'og thams cad du sprug sig sgyed ldem rnams che bar byed/ tshig rol dgu brdung thams cad la 'di bzhin rigs 'gre/ bdag gi re ba'i sems kyi sogs tshig rol dgu brdung la gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra ba las/ dgu we zhes mdun du 'jog tshul dang / de nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu gsil/ rol mo ba rnams kyi gcig gi gnyis gsum mo byas pa'i ngang nas thon/ phyi rol du gtor ma dang rnga rol sgrigs par slebs pa dang g.yas rdo rje sked par brten/

lag g.yon dril bu dang / rkang g.yon g.yas mdun du g.yob tshul byas la/ gcig gi gnyis gsum mo byas lan gsum gyi bcam la/ gsum pa'i tshe gsum mo byas la rkang g.yon bteg tsam ngos phab phral g.yas g.yon lag stabs byed mu de shig la/ gcig gi zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas glo bur du mdun la bskor/ gnyis zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis btegs cing 'phyar/ gsum mo zhes byas la rkang g.yon dang lag gnyis g.yas kyi mdun zur phab tshul/ de ltar g.yas g.yon res mos kyi 'chams ji ltar rigs par byas nas/ rol mo ba'i gral du slebs pa dang / sbraṃ zhes mdun du sgur/ sbraṃ glo bur du sked pa srang / gsum brdung gcig la rol stabs kyi g.yas bskor/ gsum brdung gcig la bsdu tshul byed pa'am/ yangs pa'i pad kor byed pa'i lugs gnyis 'dug phyi ma grwa pa rgan thog tsho'i lugs dang / snga ma gzhon thog tsho'i lugs so/ /de nas 'then rkang gcig la mdun du 'phyar/ 'then rkang gcig la sgur zhing rgyab la sgye/ dgu brdung gi 'chams gong bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'chams dal zhing dgu we zhes 'then rkang gcig la g.yas 'phyar/ yang dgu we zhes 'then rkang gcig la g.yon 'phyar/ che gcig la mdun du 'jog tshul lo/ /lugs 'di grwa bgres tsho'i yin/ yang lugs gcig la dgu brdung gi 'then rkang gcig la g.yas brkyang / gcig la g.yon brkyang / dgu brdung gi skor tshul 'dra/ rjes kyi 'then rkang gnyis la g.yas 'jog g.yon 'jog byas nas mdun du 'jog tshul 'dra ba grwa gzhon tsho'i lugs gnyis las kho bo ni rgan pa tsho'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /'chams yig na rgan pa tsho dang 'dra tsam las zhal gsal mi snang / gang ltar bzlog dbyangs la lag mgo 'gul tsam rol mo la 'chams tshul 'dra/ de 'phros 'dur shur gang rung dang rol mo dgu brdung rnams kyi 'chams tshul dang gsum brdung gi ngang nas 'gro ba dang / ji ltar rigs par bzhi 'gros kyi rol mo ba'i gral du slebs pa dang /

sbraṃ sbraṃ la dgye sgur byed tshul 'dra ba las gcig nas drug gi bar rol 'gros kyi mdun nas rgyab la bskor/ bdun brgyad la g.yas phyi la bsdu zhing g.yon mdun la bskor nas lag gnyis pad kor ltar bya/ dgu zhes pa'i tshe thugs kar mnyam/ 123gsum zhes pa rnams la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du 'jog tshul byed/ bzlog pa'i 'phros kyi lag stabs dang / tshig rol dgu brdung gi 'chams dang / gtor ma brdeg par slebs nas bzhi 'gros ci rigs byed tshul 'dra zhing 'on kyang slob dpon rol mo ba'i gral la mi 'gro/ de nas slob dpon g.yon gyi rdor dril lhan cig tu bzung nas/ phod ka'i gzhu shub g.yas ma'i sne nas bzung / lag g.yas phud phor phud chang bcas thogs la gsum brdeg len can byas la rnga rol bzhag g.yon gyi phyag mtshan lhan cig bzung ba 'di sngags 'chang chen po'i phur pa'i 'chams yig gi dgongs pa deng sang ni gser skyems thogs skabs phyag mtshan gzhan la sprod pa'i lugs gcig 'dug gang ltar yang bdud rtsi byin brlabs skabs g.yas phyogs su rgyangs la bzung / rol mo bcom pa'i tshe lag g.yas phrug tsam dang / chung gsum la rol mo dang bstun pa'i lag 'gul dang / rkang g.yas kyi rtse btsugs nas nem tsam re byed/ sbraṃ zhes pa la mdun du mnan la/ gcig gi tshe g.yas kyi rgyab zur du spos/ gnyis la mdun/ gsum la g.yon/ byas zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas bteg tsam/ yang gcig gi tshe rkang g.yas mdun/ gnyis tshe rkang g.yon rkang g.yas kyi khris/ gsum byas kyi tshe g.yas g.yas kyi rgyab zur du bzhag gcig gi tshe rkang g.yon gyi rting pa g.yas zur du btsugs/ phyogs wa zhes pa'i tshe g.yon ting 'khyer lag g.yas rgyab la gcus tsam/ de bzhin du dbyangs dang bstun rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs 'degs dus lag g.yas mdun nas bskor zhing dpung g.yon thad tsam yong ba byed/ 'bebs dus lag g.yas g.yas zur du mnan/ 'chams 'di la skad ldem yod tsam byed/

tshul des dbyangs ma rdzogs bar la rigs 'gre/ 'phrin las ne 'e ya wa ya mdzod ya zhes pa'i skabs bskor 'chams mi byed pa 'dug la lag g.yas 'gul tsam byed/ sbraṃ zhes pa'i tshe mdun du mnan/ sbraṃ zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas rgyab tu spos/ gcig la g.yas/ gnyis la mdun/ gsum byas la g.yon/ 123byas zhes pa'i 'chams tshul gong bzhin/ gcig zhes pa'i tshe gser skyems 'chams chas sogs gang la'ang ma 'thor bar byas la nam mkhar gtor/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs 'dur shur gong rnams la/ tshigs rkang re la rkang g.yas g.yon re mos kyi bteg la/ ldem 'gros kyi 'gro phyogs su gang slebs la 'gro/ dgu brdung gi 'chams tshul gong ma rnams dang 'dra/ rol mo rdzogs mtshams su gser skyems re 'thor/ rjes ma'i chems brdung la nam mkha' sa steng sa 'og gsum du gtor/ sa 'og tu 'thor gong g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi rang gi lce la myangs/ rang 'gros kyi rol mo ba'i gral du 'ongs la rdor dril thogs pas sbraṃ la sgur/ sbraṃ sgyed/ 123zhes pa la yang pad phyed ma byas la sgur/ de 'phros dgu brdung la 'chams tshul gong bzhin no/ /dpang gzugs zor lam phye ba gnyis la/ 'chams tshul tshang ma gong gi tshigs rol mo dgu brdung rnams bzhin/ zor lam dbye ba'i chems brdung rdzogs nas/ las gshin bzlog dbyangs kyi 'go'i rol 'chams dang 'dra zhing / gzhan las gtad 'chams yongs rdzogs las gshin bzlog dbyangs kyi rol 'chams sogs bzhag go /phrin las myur du sogs kyi 'then brdung skabs/ kha gtor ma rgyag sa phyogs la bltas/ dril bu mi gsil ba rkang g.yas bteg g.yas kyi rgyab zur du 'jog pa dang bstun lag g.yas g.yas phyogs la mdun nas bskor zhing bzhag g.yon gyi rkang stabs lag stabs kyang 'di dang 'dra/ de 'dra ci rigs kyi las gshin gtor ma dang nye bar phyin la/ 'then brdung rdzogs nas/ gsum brdeg 'then rkang dgu brdung sogs byed skabs/

arghaṃ dang mna' chu dam bzhag sogs byas la/ las gshin gtor ma thogs la gcig gi gnyis gsum mo bzhi zhes rol bskor dang bstun/ gtor ma lag gnyis kyi phrag pa g.yas su bteg la rkang pa g.yas kyang dus mnyam du btegs cing phab/ de bzhin du bzhi brdung gcig la rkang g.yon lag g.yon btegs cing phab/ bzhi brdung gcig la rkang g.yas btegs cing gtor ma smin mtshams su btegs la chems rdung dmod bcol gyi tshe phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar/ de grub nas sa la drag tu brdabs/ de bzhin du lcags mkhar la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /de phyin gtong deb na gsal/ 'chams tshul 'di dag kyang 'ol tshod ma yin te sngags 'chang chen po'i phur pa'i 'chams dpe snang ba 'gyur thub las/ sa chog phur btab kyi 'chams sogs tshar ba'i rjes su/ 'di skad gsungs te/ 'chams tshul 'di gong gi bka' bsgo dang phur kha bsgyur ba sogs dgu brdung bzlog pa'i rol mo lta bu gang la yang rigs 'gre bar bya zhes dang / yang 'chams dpe de nyid grub 'chams sngon 'gro'i skabs las 'di gsungs te/ mngon rtogs bzhin bdud rtsi byin brlabs mdzad nas rol mo bsgrigs te gsum brdeg len can mdzad dus 'chams tshul yod pa lhun chags pa byed zhes dang / yang de 'phros las/ rdzogs su rol mo chems brdung dang bstun la lan gsum gtor nas rang yang nyung zad gcig btung / dkar gzugs sogs phud phor chus bshal ba'i bkod pa gtsang sbras thon pa dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ rang re'i gser skyems dang zor 'chams kun la phal cher 'di bzhin la dmigs bsal bsgyur dgos rnams mthong brgyud bzhin shes par bya dgos la/ 'dir mthong brgyud phal cher yang yi ger bkod pa yin pas rang bzo med do/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod dang / drug cu pa'i cho ga phrin las tsha zer mdzad pa po zhal dkar rje drung ngag dbang shes rab 'di nyid ni chung ngu nas rgyal bstan bshad sgrub rnam dag dpal sa skya'i bka' srol 'khrul med 'dzin pa shrī e waṃ las lhan du bstan pa rin po che'i sgor byon pa nas bzung gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gtsor gyur gyi dam pa'i chos phal cher la gsan bsam rgya che zhing mkhas grub du mas rjes su bzung ba la brten nas mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan dang ldan la/

'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med cing / snyan sgrub las gsum mthar phyin pa sogs deng sang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yongs nges des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di ni 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang bar bsnyen sgrub rnam rol nas zhal skong cung zad dang bcas nag 'gros su mdzad pa yin/ drug cu pa 'di ni bshom rnams ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog phrin las char 'bebs dang / dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bsnyen sgrub rnam rol nas 'byung ba bzhin la mthong brgyud rnams kyang bkod pa yin/ dngos gzhi phrin las char 'bebs dang / bdud 'joms snang ba/ bsnyen sgrub rnam rol/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi las gshin bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rnams kyis gzhung bsrang / de gras spyan 'dren 'jam khros ma sngags bcas dang / stong gsum ma'i rgyan gyi mchod pa'i bskang ba/ myos byed stong gi sogs 'jigs byed la bdud rtsi 'bul ba dang / 'og bsgral mchod kyi skor rnams rwa rdo rje grags kyis 'jigs byed drag po'i sbyin sreg nas 'byung zhing / bgegs dang log 'dren sogs tshigs bcad gcig kyang dpe mdzad/ spyan 'dren shlau ka gcig dang / khro bo 'bar ba'i dang / de las byung ba'i dge ba sogs 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung yin/ bskul 'jom khros ma ni gshin rje gshed drag po'i rgyud rnams kyi dum bu bsdus pa yin/ las gshin gyi skor la bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod nas 'byung ba'i dpa' gcig gtor bsngo'i bstod bskul/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po zhes sogs ni slob dpon dī paṃ kā ra rakṣi tas yin/ las gshin bcu gsum ma'i skabs kyi 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol nas zhes sogs dang / dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i khrag gi mtsho/ zhes sogs dang /

bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po'i bka'/ zhes sogs nas/ de bas las 'di sgrub par gyis zhes pa'i bar rnams slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa las 'byung / khyod kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ zhes sogs mi skyod rdo rje dang / darpan a tsarya dang / glo bo lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi zin bris rnams la brten nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyi sgrig par mdzad pa yin/ zor lam dbye ba ni ldong ston gyi las byang nas 'byung ba bzhin la phyis kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis cung zad rgyas su btang ba yin no/ /las gshin gyi sngags ring gi skabs su ngor par sogs dpe kha shas na na ra singha zhes yod pas phrin las tsha zer las na ra singha yin nam snyam pas da dung dpyad dgos zhes sogs gsungs kyang / rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi drug cu go don las na ra singha ste mi'i grub pa yin par gsungs pas da lta'i ngag 'don bzhin dag 'dra/ gzhan sngags kyi go don sogs go don tshang ma 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi'i nying khu dang / go don nor bu'i phreng ba na gsal bas shes ldan dag gis de las rtogs par bya'o/ /las gtad kyi che ge zhes bya'i yul khams na zhes sogs yul dang ming rus dmigs bsal gsungs pa rnams zer dgos yod na zer/ med na spyir btang phal cher la khyed la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ bstan la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ 'di dag 'khor dang zhes kyis 'thus/ de bzhin du bsgral mchod kyi skabs su'ang / khro rgyal khyod kyi dus la babs/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /myur du sogs brjod pas 'thus/ sku rim chen mo'i gnam gang nyin gong du gsal ba bzhin la phyogs skyong la gtor sngags bdun/ las gshin la gtor sngags bdun/ mgo gnon gyi hrīḥṣṭīḥtshar gsum/ las gshin gyi sngags gnyis tshar gsum re bcas 'ur 'don/

bskang gso thugs shur bstod pa nag rngam ma/ gtor 'bul phyi 'bul dgu gtor bzhin phar ma chung na nyer gsum la byin 'bebs bdun ma phur pa bzhin/ nyer bzhi la bcu gcig ma/ nyer lnga la brgya bcu ma/ nang du las gtad kyi mjug dang / de ring khyed kyi sogs la tshigs la mnan pa'i rol mo gong bzhin gyi mjug tu/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123gcig nas bco lnga'i bar sogs rnga bun mgon po nang bzhin/ gung gseng sogs cho ga yun ring ba la dgongs nas yun ring mi bzhugs par cho ga dal brel snyoms shing 'gad gtsang yong ba dang mgyogs gtor snga phyi gang la byung kyang 'gal ba med/ dus ma'i nyer drug byin 'bebs bco lnga ma/ nyer bdun la bcu gcig ma/ nyer brgyad la bdun ma/ nyer dgu la brgya bcu ma/ tshogs dung phar ba na gnyis chang la phur bzlog tshogs dus gi thus nas zhus kyu dang gtong dgos kyang med// //ces 'phro can du lus pa 'di 'jam mgon kun blos gsung yin min brtag dgos yod// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jigs byed drug cu pa ngor lugs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
